description:
Turn the catalog visibility and the cart on or off for a channel.

This changes what WhatsApp users see in the chat with the business. Pass at least one of 'catalog_visible' and
'cart_enabled'; a value that is left out keeps its current setting.

cart_enabled.description: Whether the cart is enabled for WhatsApp users. Omit to leave unchanged.

catalog_visible.description: Whether the catalog is visible to WhatsApp users. Omit to leave unchanged.
